methodology: Verified public market data extracted strictly from published authoritative market research reports. Aggregator medians and listings without explicitly published reproducible methodologies are excluded.
confidence_methodology: HIGH: Exact rent range directly published by an authoritative market report for the exact locality and BHK. MEDIUM: Range derived reproducibly from multiple preserved source observations with sufficient sample evidence. LOW: Not used.
